name: highergov-mcp
description: HigherGov (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_highergov_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HIGHERGOV_API_KEY
platform_mcp_highergov_api_key.description: HigherGov API key (account admins: gear icon → API, per https://www.highergov.com/api-external/docs/).

platform_mcp_highergov_search_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HIGHERGOV_SEARCH_ID
platform_mcp_highergov_search_id.description: Optional HigherGov SearchID of a saved opportunity search; the API has no keyword parameter, so filtering is done by a saved search.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /api-external/opportunity/ (federal contract, DIBBS, grant and state/local opportunities; updated every 30 minutes): page_number, page_size ≤ 100, optional search_id from config. No keyword, category or budget parameter exists, so query/category/min_budget are not sent. val_est_low/high are strings (raw); source_path links to the source notice.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: Same list endpoint filtered by opp_key (the HigherGov opportunity key returned as id); an unknown key yields an empty list (invalid_input).
